notes.title: Tempest 4000 Patch
notes.content:
Hello! Thank you all so much for playing Tempest 4000! 
Our new patch is live, with refresh rate fixes and keyboard customization. Read on for a full list of updates.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32336462/e1cf711b58ddfa5a264a24e28516b6bf1c1eb384.png[/img]

• Correction of the game speed for >60Hz refresh rate.  Players can now select the resolution and refresh rate for the game.
• Keyboard Configuration – Players can now configure their keyboard controls for the game.  Players can assign up to 4 keys to an input.
• Controller Detection – Controller can be inserted/removed at any time.
• User Preferences are maintained (separately from save) that will maintain key mapping and selected video mode.
• Fix for potential memory leak.
• Other misc fixes

notes.title: Tempest 4000 is out now and just as Jeff Minter as ever
notes.content:
Jeff Minter of tiny indie outfit Llamasoft is back and hasn’t changed a bit, if Tempest 4000‘s launch today is any indication. Take the 1981 vector-graphics arcade shooter Tempest, and pile on the psychedelic laser effects, pumping ’90s techno music and weird Welsh humour until comfortably numb. It is almost excessively retro, very loud and is out now.

notes.title: Tempest 4000 set to cause sensory overload this month
notes.content:
Americans don’t know Jeff Minter in the way he’s known elsewhere. At least, that’s what I’ve been told, and it tracks because I didn’t know who Minter was either. The game creator has repeatedly butted heads with The Creature That Wears The Skin Of Atari, so it is delightful to see that some kind of common ground was reached to allow Minter to make this re-imagining of the classic arcade game Tempest. Minter was behind Tempest 2000, the widely-admired Tempest remake first released on Atari Jaguar, and has only grown more Minterly across the years through games including Space Giraffe and Polybius. Tempest 4000 is a challenging wave shooter wrapped in neon retro vibe that carries his trademark style into the future. And you can play T4000 in a couple weeks.
